principles: Expected outcomes derive from frozen rows and approved sources, never observed output.
Native positive/negative tests through ordinary runtime with genuine F1/F2, direct SQL attempts and business-state preservation.

Target high-risk scope/original access, external minimization, uncertain/unknown calendar, chronology and D020 full-day thresholds first.
V-MIG fresh/previous populated recovery and ACL preservation if no product defect blocks earlier.
Stop at first demonstrated product defect, preserve FAIL, do not repair product or expected.
Existing author tests can provide regression only, not sole independent acceptance.
All executions in disposable clone with official runner; do not modify authenticated historical context.
